draft_note: Phase 1 only. Step 0 may begin only when manifest.json exists, sealed is true, and standing_approval_application.sha256 is 64 lowercase hex characters whose status is not PLACEHOLDER_NOT_FILED. This draft is not that file. IMPLEMENTATION_QUESTIONS.md records provisional readings; they are not rulings.

precedence.e36_verbatim_governs: Inside this file, E36-1..14 verbatim text governs §2 and §3. E36 verbatim governs v1.2 and v1.1. Records ranked 1–4 are the adopted amendments to that text.

precedence_rule: A higher rank wins. Non-governing files are hashed in item 1 and any precedence claim inside them is ignored.

1.title: Full hashes of the base scope, amendment and E36 correction file, with an unambiguous precedence rule.
1.precedence_rule: See top-level precedence. Rank 1 is the B2/B3 ruling. Rank 5's E36 verbatim text governs inside v1.3 and over ranks 6 and 7. Adopted amendments from ranks 1–4 are: B2 (rank-UNRESOLVED is the only unscored rank outcome; a resolved lower rank, including sigma_1 = 0, is fitted minimum-norm and scored; one SVD supplies the rank check and the fit; rcond = 1e-10); B3 (O7 sigma stack; sigma_3/sigma_1 > 1e-6 is PIPELINE INVALID); the rank-2 record's addition that a NOT ADMISSIBLE O7 still reports sigma at the valid prefixes; closure B1 (REFERENCE RANK UNRESOLVED); closure N-a (kill at 595 s minus elapsed, soft deadline 540 s); closure N-b (per-array raw hashes).

cited_non_governing_tool.note: N2 says the standing-approval application cites this build script. It is not a governing record.

2.title: The exact W2 source commit, certificate, protocol and all implementation files.
2.no_checkpoint: No checkpoint, weight file, or training artifact is opened.

3.title: The chart notation, four-transition event order, output groups and derivative method.
3.chart: theta = (mu_x, mu_y, kappa), mu = 1 - 2 m, kappa = 4 c, c = Cov(X, Y) = p11 - m_x m_y. Inverse chart is the protocol Coordinates map. State index s = X + 2 Y. History stores reading 1 in the least significant bit.
3.event_order: Stage-k belief is the posterior after reading k and before the transition. From the stage-4 belief to the stage-8 belief the sequence is transition, reading 5, transition, reading 6, transition, reading 7, transition, reading 8. Continuation u in 0..15 covers readings 5–8. h = a + 16 u.
3.world: Uniform initial law. C ~ Bernoulli(1/5), Dx ~ Bernoulli(1/50), Dy ~ Bernoulli(1/40). Readings X, Y, X, Y, X, Y, X, Y, each BSC(1/5).
3.phi: Phi(p, u) is the terminal (q_X, q_Y, q_XOR) from the four-state filter. q_X = p10 + p11, q_Y = p01 + p11, q_XOR = p10 + p01. It is a ratio of linear functions of p. A chart perturbation uses p' = inverse_chart(theta + Delta).
3.same_fitted_maps: B and B_mu are fit on ALL output components and then used for MARG, XOR, and ALL losses.
3.derivative: Closed-form L is the quotient rule on the unnormalized linear filter map, shape (3, 3), rows (q_X, q_Y, q_XOR), columns (mu_x, mu_y, kappa). O2 compares it with central differences at step 1e-6. Maximum absolute difference must be <= 1e-8. L is cached for O3 and O6.

4.title: Exact folds, weights, pooling formulas, validity masks and coverage rules.
4.flip_action: X sends (mu_x, mu_y, kappa) to (-mu_x, mu_y, -kappa) and preserves P(h). Y sends (mu_x, mu_y, kappa) to (mu_x, -mu_y, -kappa) and preserves P(h).
4.fold_dependence: Each prefix is an evaluation prefix in 3 of the 6 folds. Continuation strings are shared.

splits_descriptive.TEST: (a + u) mod 4 = 0 gives 64 histories; the other 192 are TRAIN
splits_descriptive.VAL: (a + u) mod 4 = 2 and u != (2 - a) mod 16

4.weights: w(a, u) = P(h). Scoreable occurrences are pooled with this weight. Directions and signs have equal weight. Normalize once over the pooled scoreable occurrences. Do not average separately normalized fold losses. Unweighted values are reported alongside when a pooled statistic is formed.
4.loss: Squared error inside the group. H is the weighted mean loss of Pred_mu against the actual response. L_full is the weighted mean loss of Pred_full. S is the weighted mean squared actual response. R = H / S when S is not exactly 0. Measured gain is H - L_full.
4.scoreable_edit: For O6 and O7, an edit is scoreable only when the control's actual perturbed belief and both predicted perturbed beliefs have all four probabilities >= 1e-6. Invalid edits are omitted from the losses, kept in the coverage denominator, and never replaced.
4.coverage: Report raw-count and law-mass coverage for every scored fold and every eps_syn. Count failure is the integer test 4 * n_scoreable < 3 * n_total. Law-mass coverage is clearly below 0.75 when it is below 0.75 * (1 - 1e-6). The reference requires both measures in every fold that is scored. Question 7 records the provisional treatment of a rank-unresolved fold.
4.o4_validity: A perturbation is valid iff all four p >= 1e-6. Invalid perturbations stay in the denominator and are never replaced. O4 performs no filter propagation.

5.title: O6 and O7 state reconstruction, fitting objectives, polynomial basis and solver conventions.
5.o6_embedding: z = Q @ D^{-1} @ (theta - theta_bar). D is the diagonal of P(a)-weighted chart standard deviations over the 16 prefixes. theta_bar is the matching weighted mean. Q is 8x3 with orthonormal columns. B_true = D @ Q.T. Chart recovery is theta_bar + D @ Q.T @ z. Question 3 records that the weighting and the population divisor are provisional.
5.o6_objective: Per fold, fit B and B_mu by weighted least squares on ALL output components, fitting-prefix law weights w(a, u), and all 16 continuations. Design rows are sqrt(w) * L. The regression target is the closed-form Jacobian J = L @ B_true. The same maps are used for every output group. Neither fit is constrained to a specified rank.
5.o6_b_mu: B_mu is fit on the reduced 2-column chart design (derivatives with respect to mu_x and mu_y). A zero kappa row is then appended, so a B_mu perturbation retains baseline kappa.
5.o6_predictions: delta = eps_syn * sign * v. Pred_full = Phi(theta + B delta) - Phi(theta). Pred_mu = Phi(theta + B_mu delta) - Phi(theta). Actual = Phi(theta + B_true delta) - Phi(theta).
5.o6_expectations: On a resolved fold, max abs(B - D @ Q.T) <= 1e-9, and Pred_full matches the actual response to max abs <= 1e-9 on scoreable edits. Fits are hashed to outputs/fit_freeze_O6.json before any O6 edit is scored.
5.o7_g: g(mu_x, mu_y) = c0 + c1 mu_x + c2 mu_y + c3 mu_x^2 + c4 mu_x mu_y + c5 mu_y^2, raw monomials, P(a)-weighted least squares over all 16 reachable (mu, kappa), minimum-norm, never refit. exact_reduction_to_cross_term is true only when c0, c1, c2, c3, and c5 are exactly 0.
5.o7_baseline: Derivatives, Pred_full, and Pred_mu are taken about (mu_x, mu_y, g(mu_x, mu_y)). The actual O7 chart uses g at the perturbed (mu_x, mu_y). Disagreement with the true reachable oracle is the P(h)-weighted forecast SSE, on non-voided prefixes, against the O1 exact forecasts converted with float().
5.o7_z: z = Q2 @ ((mu_x - mean_x) / sd_x, (mu_y - mean_y) / sd_y), Q2 8x2. Question 3 records the diagonal standardization. Question 2 records that O7 directions reuse the O6 draw.
5.o7_void: A prefix is voided when any probability at its O7 baseline chart is < 1e-6. Voided prefixes are labelled RESTRICTED COMPARATOR NOT ADMISSIBLE, dropped from every fold's fit and evaluation sets, counted, and listed. If 5 or more of the 16 prefixes are voided, O7 as a whole is RESTRICTED COMPARATOR NOT ADMISSIBLE: report g's coefficients, the void list, and the sigma report; evaluate no finite predictions; continue to O3 unless the sigma stop fires.
5.o7_sigma: The sigma report stacks dPhi/dz over the non-voided fit prefixes of each fold (question 4). sigma_3/sigma_1 > 1e-6 is an integrity diagnosis, STOP, PIPELINE INVALID, no rerun. A ratio in the unresolved band is descriptive and the package continues. Resolved lower rank is reported. sigma_1 = 0 does not form ratios and is not a stop. An empty stack has no third singular value and is not a stop. Question 5 records the provisional status when g itself is rank-unresolved.
5.solver: One numpy.linalg.svd (full_matrices false) of the sqrt(w)-weighted design supplies the rank report and the minimum-norm solution. Unresolved band is [1e-10, 1e-6], endpoints included: the cell is not scored. sigma_1 == 0 yields rank 0, no ratios, a zero solution, and the cell is scored. Otherwise invert singular values with sigma_i > rcond * sigma_1, rcond = 1e-10, using that same U, S, and Vh. B2: rank-deficient means rank-UNRESOLVED only.

6.title: RNG algorithm, seeds, draw order, direction normalization, QR procedure and sign convention for Q and Q2.
6.algorithm: numpy.random.Generator(numpy.random.PCG64(seed)). Separate generators. One standard_normal draw per array.

Q.procedure: standard_normal((8, 3)), C-order; numpy.linalg.qr reduced; columns and R rows sign-flipped so diag(R) > 0

Q2.procedure: standard_normal((8, 2)), C-order; numpy.linalg.qr reduced; columns and R rows sign-flipped so diag(R) > 0

O6_directions.procedure: standard_normal((16, 8)); each row divided by its Euclidean norm; signs applied at use as +v then -v

O4_directions.procedure: standard_normal((64, 3)); each row divided by its Euclidean norm; signs applied at use as +v then -v

O7_directions.procedure: shared with O6_directions; no second draw

6.hash_at_draw: Each record stores name, seed, shape, dtype <f8, and sha256 of the C-contiguous little-endian raw bytes. The file outputs/drawn_array_hashes.json is rewritten and fsynced at each draw. The same records are copied into results.json. drawn_arrays.npz is convenience storage; its file hash is not a reproducibility check.

7.title: All thresholds, units, numerical bands, zero-denominator rules and fixture expectations.
7.units: eps_syn is the oracle edit size in standardized synthetic-chart units. Oracle outputs use the field eps_syn. The neural field eps does not occur in oracle outputs. No numerical equality between eps_syn and the neural eps is implied.
7.other_sizes: Sizes other than 0.1 are reported and never replace a failed reference.
7.rank_rule: sigma_i/sigma_1 > 1e-6 resolved nonzero; < 1e-10 resolved zero; the closed interval [1e-10, 1e-6] is UNRESOLVED. sigma_1 == 0 is rank 0 and ratios are not formed.
7.boundary_band: A float statistic x compared with threshold t is in the band when abs(x - t) <= 1e-6 * t. The band applies only to float statistics. Count coverage uses the integer test.
7.zero_response: If pooled S == 0.0 exactly, R* and L_mu/S are UNDEFINED. The label is ZERO RESPONSE. The ratio is not replaced by zero and the cell is not a pass and not PIPELINE INVALID.

fixtures.O1: Rational equality with the stored exact field, or equality with the stored 50-digit truncation. Chart round-trip, flip identities, P(h) invariance, free orbits, 64 TEST and 192 TRAIN, each prefix evaluated in 3 folds, n_O1 = 272.
fixtures.O6: max abs(B - D @ Q.T) <= 1e-9 on resolved folds; Pred_full max abs error <= 1e-9 on scoreable edits

n1_order: MET for ALL, AVAILABLE for MARG
7.consequences: For ALL, any outcome other than MET means no inference specification is drafted without a new ruling. For MARG, any outcome other than AVAILABLE means MARG is descriptive only. XOR has no section 5 label. The report states the label and the values under it.

8.title: Which outcomes stop execution, which merely describe a restricted comparator, and which determine S5.

stops.PIPELINE INVALID: O1, O2, or O6 fixture failure, or O7 sigma_3/sigma_1 > 1e-6. Exit 2. No rerun.
stops.PROJECTION HALT: T_rem > 540 - T_elapsed after the 1000-call sample. Exit 3.
stops.CAP RESERVE REACHED: T_elapsed >= 540 at the start of a stage. Write what exists and exit 4.
stops.CAP REACHED: Wrapper SIGKILL at 595 s - (now - T0), or the interpreter was not started because that budget was already exhausted. Exit 124 or 137, recorded by the wrapper.
stops.PREFLIGHT FAILED: Threads, clock, affinity, RLIMIT_AS, versions, schedule constants, or the sealed-manifest check. Exit 5. No oracle quantity is computed.

descriptive: O7 admissibility and resolved rank, except the N4(i) stop
8.determines_section5: O6 at eps_syn = 0.1, separately for ALL and for MARG, by the N1 order in item 7. A later PIPELINE INVALID replaces the package section 5 label with PIPELINE INVALID.
8.o7_not_admissible: RESTRICTED COMPARATOR NOT ADMISSIBLE does not by itself stop the package. Sigma at the non-voided prefixes is still reported. The sigma_3/sigma_1 > 1e-6 stop still applies.

9.title: Scheduled operation-count definitions, timing projection, execution order and hard-cap enforcement.
9.one_float_propagation: One float64 continuation Phi of a stage-4 belief through readings 5–8.
9.one_exact_propagation: One exact-rational stage-4 prefix filter, or one exact-rational four-reading continuation. n_O1 = 16 + 256 = 272. N_exact remaining after step 0 is 0.
9.schedule_question: Question 1. The integer 788480 is the product of the specified loops. v1.2 D-6's approximate 1e6 is not added as extra work. Exceeding 788480 is PIPELINE INVALID.
9.step0: O1, then O2, then the first 1000 O6 float64 Phi calls. Those calls are retained and used; they are not recomputed for timing. t_sample is the sum of perf_counter intervals around those calls (question 9).
9.projection: T_rem = (N_float_remaining / 1000) * t_sample. N_float_remaining = 788480 - float continuations already performed. The exact-rate term is omitted because N_exact remaining is 0. PROJECTION HALT if T_rem > 540 - T_elapsed. Overhead after step 0 is omitted from T_rem and covered by the 60 s reserve.
9.nest_provisional: Question 11. Folds in listed order, evaluation prefixes ascending, u = 0..15, baseline Phi on first use, direction rows in draw order, signs +1 then -1, eps_syn in listed order, then actual, Pred_full, Pred_mu. Question 10: guard-failing edits are still propagated.
9.wrapper: run_package.sh records T0 with date +%s.%N before any other command and exports CKAPPA_T0. It sets OMP_NUM_THREADS, MKL_NUM_THREADS, and OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS to 1, then runs prlimit --as=4000000000 -- taskset -c 0 timeout --signal=KILL <595 - (now - T0)>s python3 -m ckappa_oracle. If the remaining kill budget is <= 0, the interpreter is not started.

10.title: Runtime versions, numeric precision, CPU affinity, thread settings and memory limit.
10.precision: O1 uses exact rationals. All other numeric work is float64.
10.threads: One process. OMP_NUM_THREADS = MKL_NUM_THREADS = OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = 1, set by the wrapper and checked again before NumPy is imported.
10.affinity: taskset -c 0. The process affinity set must be exactly {0}.
10.memory_note: RLIMIT_AS soft and hard limits are both 4000000000. This is 4e9 bytes, matching the n5 cap.

11.title: Output schema and paths, partial-output behavior, and the separate post-run hash index.
11.json_rules: JSON written by the package uses indent 2, sort_keys true, allow_nan false. Non-finite floats are rejected. Writes are temp file, flush, fsync, replace, then fsync the directory.
11.incremental: Each completed stage writes outputs/stage_<id>.json and fsyncs it, including a fixture FAIL. results.json collects the stage payloads at the end. A kill loses at most the stage in progress. A projection halt during O6 does not write stage_O6 as a completed stage; the retained sample is in results.json.
11.stage_files: Each stage object includes stage, status, and the quantities defined for that stage: O1 fixtures and the split table; O2 the max absolute difference; O6 fits, coverage, pooled losses when formed, and section5_from_o6; O7 g, voids, sigma, and predictions when evaluated; O3 singular values and principal angles; O4 validity counts; O5 descriptive H and R. Oracle edit sizes appear as eps_syn.
11.report: outputs/REPORT.md states the stop kind, the section 5 labels, and the values under them. It states the ALL-not-MET and MARG-not-AVAILABLE consequences and makes no further interpretation.
11.partial_outputs: Completed outputs are kept on every stop.
11.post_run_index: The wrapper writes post_run_index.json after the process exits, for every exit status. It records T0, the exit status, the stop kind, the manifest path and sha256, and the sha256 of each output file that exists. Exit 124 and 137 are recorded as CAP REACHED. The manifest file is not modified. drawn_arrays.npz may be hashed in the index and that file hash is not the reproducibility check.

12.title: The Research Lead's application of the standing approval to this exact oracle-only scope.

The Research Lead files the standing-approval application. It cites by sha256: v1.1, v1.2, v1.3, v1.4_N, the v1.3 build script, every implementation file including run_package.sh, and the inputs at commit 5d9d8a7.
The application's path and sha256 are entered here.
The manifest is copied to manifest.json and sealed.
